simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to פְּרָזָה (H6519) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: פְּרָזָה (pᵉrâzâh) means an open country First listed occurrence: Esth 9 19.

definitions.full: H6519. perazah [ מְּרָזָה ] noun feminine open region, hamlet ; — only plural פ ׳אֶרֶץ ׃מְּרָזוֺת Ezek 38:11 a land of hamlets (opposed to חוֺמָה etc.); ׳פ יְרוּשָׁלַם תֵּשֵׁב Zech 2:8 as open regions shall Jerusalem sit ( יָשַׁב 4 ); הַמּ ׳עָרֵי Est 9:19 (opposed to שׁוּשָׁן 9:18 ); perhaps Judg 5:7 ( ׳פ for מְּרָזוֺן , compare ᵑ7 ᵑ6 GFM).
